as_told.title: Ronald Richter's fusion work and bomb promises to Perón

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher who studies claims of a secret Nazi flying-saucer program, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Ronald Richter, a German scientist who, he says, set up a project to make power from nuclear fusion in Bariloche, a town in Argentina, in the late 1940s and up to 1951. Jorjani adds that Richter was promising nuclear weapons to Juan Perón, then Argentina's leader, and that this is why an intelligence agency went down there. He tells it as a sign that German wartime science carried on in hiding after the war.
